sql.description: Check if GCP billing data is up to date for the current UTC date

flow.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM [PROTO].[dbo].[GcpBillingExport] WHERE CONVERT(DATE, ExportTime) = CONVERT(DATE, GETUTCDATE()) ) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END AS [DATA_UPTODATE];

else.script:
using System;
Console.WriteLine("Data is up-to-date. No further action required.");
